title: About
text:
InertialRange Labs AB is an AI engineering and data-platform consulting practice run by Farrukh Nauman, PhD, registered in Sweden (Aktiebolag) and based in Linköping.
I work as an AI engineer and principal consultant: I design and ship agentic systems — Text-to-SQL, coding agents, evaluation harnesses, tool contracts — against real schemas and real data on enterprise platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, Spark, Snowpark, SQL databases). When an engagement needs it, I also take interim / fractional leadership of data and AI teams. Across both, the constant is delivery: enforced retrieval, deterministic guardrails, result-level evaluation, and the test discipline that makes agents trustworthy in production.

title: About
text:
Founder
Since August 2025 I’ve been consulting through InertialRange Labs AB. As part of an ongoing engagement, I serve as interim team lead for Data Science & Advanced Analytics (Sep 2025 – Jun 2026) at a global industrial manufacturer, leading a 4–7 person team across telemetry analytics, ML, and GenAI automation — owning the roadmap, stakeholder steering, and technical direction.
Before InertialRange, I held AI researcher and consultant roles at RISE Research Institutes of Sweden (Jul 2021 – Aug 2025), where I led a Vinnova-funded applied AI project on circular fashion (project lead, ~9M SEK) and contributed as AI lead to the EU CISUTAC initiative (~2M SEK). Earlier, I held research positions at Chalmers University of Technology and the Niels Bohr Institute, and completed a PhD in Physics and Astronomy at the University of Rochester.
For my detailed profile, writing, and CV, see fnauman.com, and selected work for worked case studies.

title: About
text:
Why this company exists
Most AI and data-platform initiatives fail for predictable reasons: weak validation, underestimated data readiness, and a gap between prototypes and production. InertialRange exists to remove those failure modes with systematic evaluation, clear scope, and delivery-oriented execution.
Running my own company also lets me choose the right engagements — the ones where I can take real ownership and deliver measurable outcomes.

title: Engage
text:
Engagement models & packaged offers
Senior delivery without an open-ended project — sized from a two-week audit to a multi-month interim lead, with scope and acceptance criteria agreed up front.


Hands-on AI engineering
Embedded principal: I build the thing and write the code — agents, guardrails, evals, tool contracts — alongside your team. Evaluation-first: I prove correctness before I optimize, and show evidence before I ship.


2-week Discovery / Data & Feasibility Audit
Clarify the use case, assess data readiness, and find the fastest path to value.
You leave with: a data readiness assessment, a prioritized opportunity map (ROI × risk), success metrics and an evaluation approach, a risk register, and recommended next steps.


4-week Pilot (fixed scope, acceptance criteria)
Build and validate a pilot against criteria agreed up front.
You leave with: acceptance criteria, a working pilot and evaluation results, and a production handoff plan (architecture + next-step roadmap).


Fractional / interim lead
Senior technical leadership for data & AI teams — from 1–2 days/week up to a full interim team-lead engagement (currently leading a 4–7 person DS & advanced analytics team). Roadmap ownership, stakeholder steering, reviews, unblockers, and delivery accountability.

title: Engage
text:
How it works

Intro call — a short conversation to assess fit and define the problem.
Scope — a lightweight proposal with deliverables, timeline, and dependencies.
Kickoff — align on success criteria and get access to data/systems.
Delivery — weekly check-ins and fast feedback cycles.
Handoff — deliverables, documentation, and a clear next-step roadmap.

title: Engage
text:
Practicalities

Legal entity: InertialRange Labs AB (Swedish Aktiebolag) — invoicing in SEK or EUR.
Location & mode: based in Linköping, Sweden — remote-first across the Nordics and EU, with onsite for kickoffs and key milestones.
Fit: strongest where there’s real data, a real production target, and a stakeholder who wants ownership and evidence — not a strategy deck or a research paper.
Confidentiality: comfortable working under NDA and within existing security/compliance constraints.
